versions.changelog:
Initial release—expert, neutral webcam buying consultation skill.

- Interviews users about their use case, environment, and hardware setup to determine webcam specs tailored to their needs.
- Covers key details like resolution, sensor size, aperture, autofocus, field of view, microphone quality, lighting, mounting, and connectivity.
- Provides structured, unbiased recommendations without favoring brands.
- Helps users avoid overspending on unnecessary features or underspending on essential specs.
- Designed for anyone seeking clear webcam buying advice, from first-timers to experienced upgraders.
